READINESS GATE

Generation today ignores validateMetric() entirely. Here it reads it: errors block the FINAL document, drafts stay open so incomplete work can still be circulated for review.

The prose "review loop" card is gone — the loop is the screen now.

CLEARED STATE

The FINAL button unlocks only with a stated acknowledgement of the remaining warnings. "Since v7" is the bridge into the diff view.

Open question: should FINAL also require zero warnings, or is acknowledgement enough?

VERSION DIFF (interactive — click v5 / v6 / v7)

Answers the question the version table cannot: what moved since I last read this. "Errors introduced" catches regressions between drafts.

Needs a headline-value snapshot stored per generation.
